  • XBUAutomation BypassAutomation_Bypass__cCheckboxcreated Aug 30, 2026
    Set to true by automation when it must close or abandon a Case that cannot supply the normally required fields.   • XBUDiary Date/TimeActOnIt__DiaryDateTime__cDate/Timecreated Oct 1, 2026
    Act On It will fire a push notification to the Case Owner at the specified date/time to draw their attention to the Case*. This field is designed to enable service professionals to quickly and easily set reminders from the Case record and/or AOI messages (quick actions). e.g. 'Remind me to follow up in a few days to check in on the progress of the escalation team'. *For this feature to work, the automation responsible for delivering push notifications must be activated via the 'Notifications' tab of the Act On It lightning application.

    Indicates whether the payment was Customer Initiated or Merchant Initiated. Used for Card-on-File compliance tracking.
  • SBUPayment TypeChargentBase__Payment_Type__cPicklistcreated Sep 15, 2026
    Indicates whether this transaction represents the Initial use of payment credentials or a Subsequent transaction using a previously stored payment method. This classification supports card network requirements for stored credential transactions.
Chargent SettingsChargentBase__Chargent_Settings__c1 field
  • SBUDefault Charge UsageChargentBase__Default_Charge_Usage__cText (50)created Sep 15, 2026
    Defines the default payment initiator classification for subsequent charges using existing Payment Methods. Used for Card-on-File compliance. Valid values: 'Customer Initiated Transaction' or 'Merchant Initiated Transaction' (singular, matching Payment_Initiator__c picklist). The UI displays these as plural labels.
Chargent TokenChargentBase__Token__c2 fields
  • SBUPayment IntentChargentBase__Payment_Intent__cPicklistcreated Sep 15, 2026
    Indicates the standing instruction type for stored credential transactions. This value is set on the initial transaction and used for subsequent payments to comply with card network stored credential mandates. - Unscheduled: Ad-hoc payments using stored credentials (default) - Recurring: Ongoing subscription with no defined end date - Installment: Fixed schedule of payments with a defined end
  • SBUStored Credential ReferenceChargentBase__Stored_Credential_Reference__cText (255)created Sep 15, 2026
    Four-state stored credential anchor field. Values: null = legacy token (pre-upgrade, NTI never captured); Token Only = registered post-upgrade, no initial charge yet; Network ID Pending = charged, gateway not yet wired for NTI capture; <real ID> = network transaction ID, fully classified and ready for MIT.

Lead1 field
  • SBUSouth Asian Last NameSouth_Asian_Last_Name__cFormula (Checkbox)created Mar 1, 2022
    TRUE when the Lead LastName matcheAs a known South Asian surname. The list is held as a semicolon-delimited blob and matched with CONTAINS, because one OR/CASE clause per name hits the 3,900-character formula limit at about 140 names. This encoding costs ~7 characters per name instead of ~15-27, so all 357 names fit in one field with room for roughly 160 more. To add a name: insert it lowercase between two semicolons. Do not create a second formula field and OR them together - Salesforce inlines referenced formulas, so the combined compiled size exceeds the 5,000-byte limit.
